answer: Operator Liability Bridge: each wallet links to a legal payout account that receives all earnings. If two wallets share any operator signal (same bank, device, or payout route), the system freezes both payout accounts and charges the operator a fixed penalty of 50,000 ivory credits per duplicate, collectable from future earnings. An attacker building a gale of sock-puppets therefore faces a deterministic 50,000-credit liability per identity, payable before any withdrawal clears.
